blocks.text: AI-powered search engine that gives answers, not just links

Perplexity reimagines search by giving you answers instead of links. Ask a question, and Perplexity searches the web, synthesizes information from multiple sources, and presents a clear answer with inline citations. Click any citation to verify the source - combining AI convenience with information transparency.

For research-heavy workflows - competitive analysis, market research, technical investigation - Perplexity dramatically reduces the time from question to insight. Instead of opening ten tabs, scanning articles, and synthesizing information manually, you get a structured answer in seconds.

The Pro Search feature handles multi-step research tasks, asking clarifying questions and iterating through multiple search queries to build comprehensive answers. For complex topics that require piecing together information from diverse sources, this depth of research is genuinely useful.
Get synthesized answers with inline citations from web sources
Multi-step research that asks clarifying questions and goes deeper
Every claim is linked to its source for verification
Search specific sources - academic papers, YouTube, Reddit, news
Save and organize research threads for ongoing projects
Integrate Perplexity search into your own applications

Perplexity has replaced traditional search for most of our research needs. The combination of AI synthesis and source citations gives us faster insights while maintaining the ability to verify claims.
Our team can integrate Perplexity into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
